pages.raw_meta: Alaska Power & Telephone delivers reliable Internet, phone, and power services across Alaska, connecting communities with dependable local service.
raw_blocks: Alaska’s Best Fiber Internet & Energy Provider
Sustainable Energy & Power Solutions
Welcome to Alaska Power & Telephone

We are an employee-owned utility dedicated to serving over 40 Alaska communities with reliable power, broadband, and telephone services. Since 1957, we’ve built our reputation on trust, innovation, and a deep commitment to the people and places we serve.

Whether you’re a residential customer looking for dependable energy, a business seeking enterprise connectivity, or a visitor checking local conditions via our popular webcam feature, AP&T is here to support your journey.
Our fiber and microwave networks connect homes and businesses with speeds up to 2.5 Gbps—competitive with national providers.
We deliver reliable energy from the Arctic Circle to Southeastern Alaska, with hydroelectric power playing a key role of our sustainable solution.
Use SmartHub to pay & manage your account, find quick answers to common questions, and check the weather with Live Webcams.
We invest locally through donations, event sponsorships, energy incentives and education. Empowering our communities empowers us all.

AP&T delivers reliable utility services to over 40 remote Alaska communities and villages across 1,100 linear miles. With a strong commitment to sustainability, approximately 75% of AP&T’s energy is generated from renewable hydropower. In select areas, surplus energy supports beneficial electrification initiatives—such as heat pump installations and electric vehicle adoption—driving clean energy growth and long-term environmental resilience.

pages.raw_title: AP&T Business Services | Reliable Solutions for Your Business
pages.raw_meta: AP&T Business Services delivers reliable, scalable solutions to help your business operate efficiently and grow with confidence.
raw_blocks: Business Internet, Data Services, Calling Solutions, & Energy Solutions
We deliver the personalized service of a small, local company, but offer advanced technology solutions and resources of a large enterprise.

At AP&T, we provide the advanced connectivity and energy solutions businesses need to thrive. From high-speed broadband and custom data services to reliable telephone and energy services, our business solutions are built on cutting edge infrastructure—including regional fiber networks and 24/7 support.
With local technicians, dedicated account monitoring, and dependable, Alaska proven technology, we deliver the performance of a major provider with the hands on support of a local partner.

Broadband business internet is a high-speed internet connection specifically tailored to businesses. Broadband business internet makes sure to have enough bandwidth, connectivity, and connection for your business needs throughout the entire process. Broadband also offers reliable download and upload speeds to accommodate your needs.
The below Standard Business Broadband Tiers plans are available in all AP&T service areas, except for Wrangell & Metlakatla.
View Standard Business Broadband Tiers

Benefit from a complimentary static IP, ensuring stable equipment maintenance without worrying about address changes.
Tired of having a bad Wi-Fi signal throughout your business? Get Plume, our mesh Wi-Fi solution, to have reliable and consistent connection.
Eliminate the constraints of data caps in your business connectivity. Stream and access data for your professional needs without limitations.
For data services please contact sales@aptalaska.com

Dedicated Internet Access (DIA) is a high-speed private internet connection which is highly secure. Offering untethered bandwidth and uninterrupted services, DIA allows for a seamless and reliable connection for any needs you may have. Where digital access is imperative for business and personal endeavors, having Dedicated Internet Access (DIA) by your side is not just a suggestion, but a necessity.

Ethernet (ETS) connects devices over a unified network incorporating local area networks (LANs) and can also be used for wide area networks (WANs). Ethernet services connect devices over a cable, whereas Wi-Fi connects devices over wireless signals, providing faster, more stable and more secure connections than Wi-Fi networks. Ethernet can act as the bridge between your endless networks.

Managed service internet involves a third-party monitoring and managing a business’s internet connection. Managed service internet aspires to identify items of interest before the business team can, leading to increased productivity and growth in the business. Managed service internet assists in finding the best possible connection in the nearby area, promoting enhanced productivity.
Powering Your Business with Reliable Energy
At AP&T, we provide large commercial consumers with bulk power rates regulated by the Regulatory Commission of Alaska (RCA).
Our energy is generated through a dependable mix of diesel generation and hydroelectric plants, ensuring both stability and sustainability.

Alaska is one of the most challenging places to live and work—but our dedicated line crews make it easier. Through harsh weather and rugged terrain, they work tirelessly to keep you connected. Their commitment ensures that your business has the reliable power it needs, no matter the conditions.
If you’re establishing a new commercial service, simply complete our online form, and an AP&T representative will contact you to schedule a site visit.
